description: Renews a domain registered here by 1-10 years; anyone may pay, no token needed or given. Domains without an owner account get no expiry reminders. Paid, no account: without payment it answers payment_required with this order's price (valid 15 minutes), a Lightning invoice (L402) and a Cashu request, after every free check passed (no invoice otherwise). Pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with exactly the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or cashu='<token>' (a Cashu token is melted into the service's Lightning wallet at once; if the mint does not pay, the token stays yours). Free quote first: domain_check.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. example.com (an offered TLD: info, domains.tlds).

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

name: domain_renew
title: Renew a domain registered here, no account (live price in sats)
